# PLG TikTok Studio

## When to use
TikTok, TikTok Studio, FYP, dual-post with YouTube, Buffer TikTok.

## Rules
1. Read workflow/tiktok-studio-os.md.
2. One master 9:16 file. Never a second edit for TikTok.
3. Write `jobs/{date}_{slug}/tiktok.md` with caption, cover ms, toggles.
4. Keep text out of bottom 250px and right rail.
5. Disclose AI when Suno/AI visual is used.
6. Do not call Buffer create_post on hustleguru46 while the channel is disconnected.
7. Same hook as the YouTube packet. Same day window.
